Featured Project: Cabinet Master Macro

🚀 Automated Cabinet Design & Assembly System

Developed a comprehensive VBA-based macro system in SolidWorks 2022 that automates the creation of parametric cabinet designs with customizable dimensions, materials, and hardware specifications.

Key Achievements:

  • Merged 3 independent recorded macros into unified automation system
  • Created dynamic UserForm interface for dimension input
  • Automated generation of 6 cabinet panels + variable door creation
  • Implemented intelligent file management & folder creation
  • Developed assembly automation with proper component positioning
  • Maintained precision: 1/16" panel gaps, 1/8" door spacing
  • Zero collision detection with proper geometric alignment
  • Comprehensive logging and error handling system

Impact: Reduced cabinet design time from 2-3 hours to 5 minutes per design.
